name: Forced displacement
summary: Yemen fighting displaced 300,000+ over two months; Darfur flight continues; no event over 500,000 in a month found
state: IOM said on 1 Nov that more than 300,000 people had fled fighting in western Yemen, almost all over the previous two months since hostilities intensified in September (Khaleej Times, citing AFP). In Sudan, IOM said on 12 Nov that more than 5,200 people fled villages in North and South Darfur over three days, most into Chad (Anadolu via A News). Neither reaches 500,000 in a month, and searches on 17 Nov found no other new mass displacement event, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Those most exposed are civilians in western Yemen and Darfur, and neighbouring Chad, which receives most people fleeing Darfur. Large new flows tend to strain camps and aid budgets that are already stretched.
rubric_hit: No new event displacing >500,000 in a month; Yemen ~300,000 over two months is below the Watch line
